issue.title: Remove stale Symvision epic-symbol exemptions for closed bead sase-1i4.3
issue.description:
## Bug

- **Location:** `Justfile` `_lint-symvision` recipe (lines ~413-419): seven `--epic-symbol 'sase-1i4.3(...)'` entries

Bead sase-1i4.3 (Orphaned agent scope reaper job) is CLOSED, so every `just _lint-symvision` run fails with 7 stale-whitelist errors and `just check` can never go green:

```
Error: --epic-symbol 'sase-1i4.3(ScopeMember)': bead 'sase-1i4.3' is closed. Remove this stale --epic-symbol entry and clean up the symbol.
(... same for ScopeSweepPlan, ScopeSweepResult, execute_scope_sweep, is_agent_runner, plan_scope_sweep, read_scope_members)
```

Repro: `just _lint-symvision` on a clean tree (fails identically every run, including twice in one session — deterministic, not a flake). The `src/sase/agent/scope_sweep.py` symbols the entries whitelisted (`plan_scope_sweep`, `execute_scope_sweep`, `read_scope_members`, `is_agent_runner`, `ScopeMember`, `ScopeSweepPlan`, `ScopeSweepResult`) are now reported as unused public symbols when the flags are dropped, so the fix must also resolve those symbols per `sase/memory/symvision.md` (delete, privatize, or re-key onto an open bead — likely delete if the scope-reaper phase never landed consumers).

Impact: blocks `just check` / `just _lint-symvision` for every agent on master; unrelated to any in-flight split work.
